comment.narrative:
PS strategies are aligned with the SDG’s and Enabling environment for inclusive business is created
The role of Private Sector in skills development is improved and increased

Resilience among MSMEs is improved and private sector and foundations are better engaged in crisis response

- Training Programme “Municipal Enterprises for Local Authorities” will be conducted in cooperation with UN Habitat and UNDP Inclusive Growth Team - Research on The Role of Municipal Enterprises for Immediate Local Response to COVID19 - Technical Assistance on Establishing and Building Local Capacity in Production of Personal Protection Equipment (PPEs) through South-South Cooperation in Partnership with Uluslararasi Saglik A.S (USHAS) - IICPSD will propagate Solar Solutions in Africa through Private Sector Engagement through its South-South Cooperation portfolio. - IICPSD will lead the research “Medical Waste Ecosystem in Turkey: Lessons learnt during COVID-19”. - World Urban Forum 10, 8-13 February 2020 - Training Program on Municipal Enterprises for Local Authorities in Turkey, September, 2020. - Training Program on Municipal Enterprises for Local Authorities in Palestine, October, 2020. - IICPSD will continue working with UN Habitat, UCLG and CEEP through its South-South Cooperation portfolio. - “Integrating the Labour Force to 3D Design and Printing Value-Chain” study - “Prefeasibility study on ‘Innovative Skills Development Financing in India’” study - “Entrepreneurship in Africa and the Promises of the Key Sectors” study - Technical support to UNDP India on innovative skills development financing - Technical support to UNDP Africa’s YouthConnekt initiative on skills development and entrepreneurship development - Provide technical support for cutting-edge technologies such as AI and ML for digital development solutions to UNDP offices and development stakeholders - Advance mainstreaming digital transformation in the private sector and development space through skilling, upskilling and reskilling - Operationalize IICPSD-EBRD joint initiative multi-stakeholder advisory network ‘Skills for an Inclusive Future’ and launch during UNGA - Roll out IICPSD-UNV “Digital Transformation through Volunteerism” initiative - Provide digital development solution, research and advisory through SDG AI Lab initiative - Enhance the joint the ‘Entrepreneurial Skills Development Initiative for SDGs’ with the HP Foundation through global training of trainers and global capacity building program - Support digital transformation and Industry 4.0 skills of chambers in OIC member states together with ICCIA, in coordination with SESRIC - Continue working in collaboration with UNDP India, KOIS Invest, and NSDC to advance innovative financing strategies and tools for India’s skills development process - Support the activities of SDG Impact Accelerator (SDGia) which will initiate a partnership with the UN Technology Bank for technology transfer to the LDCs, support new calls on health-tech and financial inclusion, and engage impact investors to direct resources to SDGia - Replicate the impact investing ecosystem study in other countries (Morocco, Ukraine, Kazakhstan) - Generate knowledge products on impact investing - Islamic Finance and Impact Investing Training will be replicated in other countries: Morocco (completed) and Kazakhstan (tbc) - Six impact investing events and capacity building seminars are planned to be conducted or supported, outreaching over 500 stakeholders through these events. - Over 50 impact creating enterprises and 50 responsible/ impact investors are targeted to be reached through advocacy activities or one-on-one interviews. - IICPSD’s impact investing focus will be more geared towards implementation of these research outputs through technical assistance services.

IICPSD Implemented its activities under four thematic areas 1 - Private Sector Engagement through South-South Cooperation for the SDGs; 2 - Private Sector Engagement in Digital Transformation and Skills Development; 3 - Impact Investing; 4 - Resilience and Crisis Response. To engage the private sector through South-South Cooperation for the SDGs IICPSD organized a training programme on Municipal Enterprise for Local Authorities for the local authorities of Azerbaijan and Albania and a training programme on Inclusive and Sustainable Waste Management in Turkey A Country based survey on Solid Waste Management Ecosystem has been conducted in Uruguay, Tunisia, Argentina through International Solid Waste Association National Committees. The country-based survey will be conducted in 10 target countries in the first quarter of 2022. IICPSD released two publications Lessons Learnt and Strategies for Local Manufacturing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for COVID 19 Response Based on Literature Review, Experience and Case Study from Turkey USHAS. and Medical Waste Ecosystem in Turkey . Under digital transformation and skills in 2021, jointly with EBRD, IICPSD launched Skills for an Inclusive Future Network within the margins of the High-Level Political Forum. S4IF is onboarding the initial cohort of private sector members and began work on a Country Chapter in collaboration with UNDP Turkey CO. Under SDG AI Lab, IICPSD provides research, development and advisory support through cutting-edge digital solutions in harnessing the potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and GIS for sustainable development. Moreover, the Lab is actively engaging online volunteers into SDGs related digital projects through its Volunteer Data Scientists initiative. Under the partnership with HP Foundation, IICPSD conducted seven capacity development trainings in Egypt for the academic staff of four academic institutions. Moreover, IICPSD partnered with YouthConnekt Africa (YCA) to enhance 21st century and entrepreneurial skills development in Africa. Under this collaboration, IICPSD and YCA agreed on a multi-year workplan to implement capacity development activities. In 2021, IICPSD has expanded its impact investing services both in developing and developed countries. The center has published The SDG Investor Map Turkey . The map was lunched in a High-Level Policy Dialogue event during the 11th Bosphorus Summit in March 2021 with the participation of the President of Turkey Recep Tayyip Erdogan and UNDP Administrator Achim Steiner as keynote speakers. In addition to the SDG Investor Maps in Turkey, and Ukraine. The center supported 9 Countries for the SDG Investor Maps in South Africa, Kenya, Nigeria and Rwanda and ecosystem studies and SDG Investor Maps in Tunisia, Morocco, Djibouti, Eswatini and Mauritius. IICPSD contributed to the Green Sukuk Initiative in Uzbekistan with an assessment report. IICPSD prepared Djibouti Islamic Microfinance Assessment and Strategy Development and Engaging Islamic Finance Modalities with Djibouti Partial Credit Guarantee Fund. The center also delivered the policy brief on “The Afghan Banking and Financial System- Status and Options to avoid Collapse” which received high interest in international media. The FSH team, under the leadership of the Istanbul Center, and in partnership with the NCE team provided technical assistance through the GPN on the SDG Joint Fund Component 2 proposals on SDG Financing. UNDP is the first ranked organization participating in 7 out of 9 top ranking Joint Programmes and is lead in 5 (with participation of UNCDF as a key partner in 3) out of the 9 programmes out of 155 projects submitted.
